result.summary: The image shows a sidewalk separated from the roadway by a grass buffer, running alongside a tall brick wall topped with a chain-link fence. There are no visible pedestrian crossings, signals, or street lighting in the immediate vicinity, creating a sterile environment for walking.

hazards.name: Lack of marked crossing
hazards.description: There are no designated areas for pedestrians to cross the street safely within the visible area.

hazards.description: No visible street lights, which may reduce visibility and safety for pedestrians at night.

hazards.name: Visual obstruction from parked vehicle
hazards.description: The parked blue car partially blocks sight lines between pedestrians on the sidewalk and oncoming traffic.

result.summary: The street is a two-lane roadway with sidewalks on both sides, though they are narrow and lack a buffer from the road on the right. hazards.name: Unmarked travel lanes

result.summary: The pedestrian environment is a residential intersection lacking basic safety infrastructure such as marked crosswalks and curb ramps. While a stop sign controls the side street, the wide, unmarked main roadway and parked vehicles create potential hazards for crossing pedestrians.

hazards.name: Unmarked Crossing
hazards.description: There are no painted crosswalks at the intersection, leaving pedestrians without a designated or protected path across the roadway.
hazards.location_in_image: Intersection area in the foreground and middle ground.

hazards.name: Lack of Curb Ramps
hazards.description: The absence of curb ramps makes the transition from sidewalk to street difficult for individuals with mobility impairments or strollers.

hazards.name: Visual Obstructions from Parked Cars
hazards.description: Cars parked close to the intersection on the side street may block the sight lines between drivers and pedestrians.
hazards.location_in_image: Right side of the side street.

interventions.title: High-Visibility Crosswalks
interventions.description: Install high-visibility continental crosswalk markings to clearly define pedestrian paths.

interventions.title: ADA-Compliant Curb Ramps
interventions.description: Install curb ramps with detectable warning surfaces at all crossing points.

interventions.title: Intersection Daylighting
interventions.description: Restrict parking near the intersection to improve visibility for all road users.
